task: ae.regex: pattern parser + Thompson NFA + canonical minimal DFA + leftmost-longest find + equivalence witnesses + boolean algebra + counting
reasoning_summary: Compiled patterns to a Thompson NFA, then a complete DFA over character-class intervals, minimised with Moore refinement into a canonical form so equal languages are structurally equal. Tests are table-driven plus seeded differential runs against java.util.regex and brute-force oracles, with mutation kill-checks. Three test runs were needed: two failures were my own wrong hand-counted expectations (interval class counts, an empty-match position), not code bugs.
